atoms.text: In 1927, the American artist Gutzon Borglum designed a sculpture that shows the faces of four presidents of the USA: George Washington, Thomas Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Abraham Lincoln. They represent the first 150 years of the USA. The sculpture was finished in 1941.

b: the last 150 years of the USA

atoms.text: Thomas Jefferson was the third president of the United States. He was president for two terms and started his presidency in 1801. Before he became president, Thomas Jefferson was involved in the War of Independence. He wrote a letter that explained why the colonies in America shouldn't be under control of Great Britain. That's why he's also known as “Father of the Declaration of Independence”.

atoms.text: Abraham Lincoln was the 16th president of the United States. He was president from 1861-1865. That's one term. Abraham Lincoln was involved in the Civil War. He is known for ending slavery in the United States. He is also the first president of the USA who was assassinated.

atoms.text: Theodore Roosevelt was the 26th president of the United States. He was president for two terms, from 1901-1909. Theodore Roosevelt was known for his negotiation skills because he helped other countries solve problems. Theodore Roosevelt wanted to be president for a third term, but he was shot in the chest during a speech. He survived the attack but wasn't elected again.
